Rosary High School, Navelim, Salcete, Goa has invited applications for the following posts on a regular basis:

📌 Available Positions & Qualifications:

Undergraduate Teacher (Mathematics and Science): B.Sc. and B.Ed.

Undergraduate Teacher (English and Social Science): B.A. and B.Ed.

Undergraduate Teacher (Indian Languages): B.A. and B.Ed.

Lower Division Clerk (LDC): 01 Vacancy | Class XII pass with computer knowledge.

📋 Eligibility & Conditions:

* Candidates must possess the required qualifications as prescribed under applicable Government Recruitment Rules.

* Must be below 45 years of age.

* Must hold a valid Employment Exchange Registration.

* Must possess a valid Residence Certificate.

✉️ How to Apply:

* Prepare your full biodata with accurate personal, educational, and contact details.

* Attach copies of relevant educational certificates, Employment Exchange Registration, Residence Certificate, and other supporting documents.

* Clearly mention the name of the post applied for on the envelope.

* Submit the application to the Manager/Headmistress, Rosary High School, Navelim, Salcete, Goa.

* Ensure that the application reaches the school within the prescribed seven-day period.

⏰ Last Date to Apply: On or before 26th Oct 2026.
📰 Source: Navhind Times | Date: 20-10-2026.
